# Reliable outbox — collaborative Harbor prototype

This standalone software engineering task asks an agent to implement a durable, multi-tenant SQLite event outbox. The task covers atomic fanout, canonical-payload idempotency, partition FIFO, fenced leases, retries, and restart recovery.

**Status: technically validated prototype. It does not satisfy the sample invitation’s exclusion of work mostly generated by AI as written. It must not be represented as an eligible submission without an explicit exception from the organizer. Actual long-horizon difficulty has not been calibrated.**

The user supplied approved prior task material as conceptual background. Codex prepared the new specification, starter, reference implementation, verifier and packaging. See [the authorship disclosure](reliable-outbox/AUTHORSHIP.md). No Silver code, image, hidden tests or reference solution was copied into this task.

## Reproduce

With Python 3.11+, Harbor and Docker installed, run from this repository’s root:

```sh
python3 validation/frontierswe-check.py reliable-outbox
harbor run -p reliable-outbox -a oracle --jobs-dir jobs
harbor run -p reliable-outbox -a nop --jobs-dir jobs
```

The task folder is [`reliable-outbox/`](reliable-outbox). Its environment contains only the starter module and a digest-pinned Python base image. The 20-hour agent timeout is a budget, not evidence of a human solve duration. No real targets, credentials or external application services are involved. Revalidate after any task-file change.

The public reference solution and grading files belong to the author/reviewer package; the agent-facing image excludes them. There is no submission or organizer acceptance implied by this repository.
